changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Retain the remaining reconciliation range across cancellation and restart.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE google_health.sync_state ADD COLUMN reconciliation_start timestamptz, ADD COLUMN reconciliation_end timestamptz, ADD COLUMN daily_reconciliation_start timestamptz, ADD COLUMN daily_reconciliation_end timestamptz;
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE google_health.sync_state DROP COLUMN reconciliation_start, DROP COLUMN reconciliation_end, DROP COLUMN daily_reconciliation_start, DROP COLUMN daily_reconciliation_end;
